subject: Re: Humain <> Encord | Partnership Next Steps
text:
Hi Leo,

I've reviewed the market study deliverable and unfortunately it does not meet the agreed-upon scope.

To be clear, the request was for a market study focused specifically on data annotation services in the MENA region. What was delivered is a study on the AI stack landscape - a fundamentally different topic. While the content may have value in other contexts, it does not serve the purpose for which it was commissioned and cannot be used as a basis for our GTM planning.

We need this corrected. Please revise the study to focus on:

* Data annotation market sizing and growth projections in MENA
* Competitive landscape of annotation service providers in the region
* Demand drivers, buyer segments, and pricing benchmarks
* Gaps and opportunities specific to Arabic language annotation

Please share a revised timeline for delivery and reschedule the meeting.

We appreciate the partnership and looking forward to getting this right together.

Best,

subject: Re: Encord Technical Onboarding - Recording + Slides
text:
Hi Nikhil,

Nice to e-meet you too!

Perhaps already sharing some high-level insights would help while the
annotation guidelines are being prepared. Let me share the following:

As a starting point, we are looking for three types of annotations:

   - Instrument readout: Interpret the numerical value (including units, if
   applicable) from the various instrument types shown in the images
      - Annotation type: Bounding boxes
      - Supported instrument types:
         - Analog gauge
         - Analog counter
         - Digital display
         - Level gauge
         - Fluid level
      - This draft annotation guideline
      <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1m4-ZPaiV231d0d-Hz18oL2N8s5SEf52iEzrUIwzcaPc/edit?usp=sharing>
better
      explains the expected format for the dataset and annotations. Note that
      this guideline is an initial draft, it has not yet been reviewed and may
      lack example pictures or even contain missing information.
   - Object detection: Open-ended object detection (the object of interest
   varies for different inspections and will be defined per inspection)
      - Annotation type: Bounding boxes
      - Given the open-ended / dynamic nature of this annotation type, we
      still need to explore the best way to set up the ontology and annotation
      instructions.
      - Therefore, finalizing the annotation instructions for this type of
      annotation might take more time.
   - Change detection: Open-ended change detection given temporal context
   (e.g. checking whether objects have moved over time)
      - Similar to the object detection annotation type, this also requires
      more exploration on the best way to set up the annotation method.
      - Therefore, finalizing the annotation instructions for this type of
      annotation might take more time.

Let me know if this context is sufficient for your sourcing effort. I am
happy to provide more information to help.

Best,
Yi Hao

subject: Re: Encord - Interest
text:
Hi Hugo,

Thanks for the follow up and your patience.

We are the fastest growing *data labeling and annotation* company based in
India, supporting AI and ML teams with image, video, text, and audio
annotation work.

We have *7+ years of experience* and have completed *2,500+ projects* for
100+ clients, including Fortune 10, Fortune 100, and Global 500 companies.
We follow CMMI Level 3 processes, are ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, and
are an AWS partner.

Our team works on common annotation tasks such as *bounding boxes,
segmentation, key-points, polygons, and similar techniques*, supporting use
cases across computer vision, medical imaging, retail, autonomous systems,
and more.

We offer a* free pilot project* so you can review our quality and workflow
at no cost. Our pricing is flexible and typically ranges around *$2 per
hour*, with options for *per-image or per-annotation pricing*, depending on
your requirements. We are looking for partnership with platform providers.
If this is relevant to you, I’d be happy to connect for a short call. If
not, I would appreciate it if you could guide me to the right person in
your team who handles data annotation needs.

To know more about us, please have a look at our website
<https://learningspiral.ai/>.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your response.
